scope: Impeccable S1/S2, source math editor and actual read-only OCR renderer

baseline.cause: HTML-only KaTeX output hides the visual tree from accessibility without providing MathML; editorTokens is also used by the read-only OCR reader.

libraryAssumptions.visualOutput: The entire katex-html subtree and data-export-tex value match the existing HTML-only output; the repair and trust rules are unchanged.
libraryAssumptions.source: prepareVisualDocument removes rendered children from raw data-math-tex tokens; documentMarkdown saves the original node attrs, not accessibility markup.
libraryAssumptions.export: TipTap HTML stays metadata-only; HWPX reads data-export-tex and excludes text descendants of katex. The separate print/library renderer and PDF request path are unchanged.

confirmed.browser: Headless Chromium via Playwright, isolated Vite harness on port 4249
confirmed.names: Existing 문제 본문/정답 field context plus current LaTeX expression, refreshed on edits and reopening
confirmed.keyboard: Real browser Enter/Space activation and Escape/Enter closing
confirmed.editing: MathLive value assignment plus input dispatch, actual TipTap update, source serialization, save and remount
confirmed.clipboard: Native Ctrl+C plain text matches the old visual-only DOM exactly; native text/html excludes MathML and annotations; semantic trees are restored after copying
confirmed.layout: Byte-identical screenshots and matching formula rectangles with/without MathML in screen and print media
confirmed.hwpx: Three equations emitted once each, no semantic-only text, and identical layout objects with/without MathML
confirmed.eslint: Exit 0, zero errors, four existing native-image warnings

limits: No physical screen-reader speech, math navigation, or pronunciation test; access-tree evidence is not a speech certification.
Browser and native clipboard checks cover Chromium, not Firefox or WebKit.
Screen/print media comparisons use synthetic local fixtures; no generated production PDF or HWPX file was requested.
No real OCR/AI calls, database writes, production writes, dependency install, or Prisma generation.
Global TypeScript validation and integration are the coordinator's responsibility.
